SHORT.Finding: **SPEC'D 2026-09-03, awaiting operator pick (operator: "the chords shown under the circle of fifths have been a surprisingly nice tool for me to write progressions before using compose tab. what is the pattern here we can enable?")**. Pattern named: **audition-first composing** - the Studio's chords-in-key strip is a PALETTE (zero commitment per tap, 7 chips all correct by construction, auditioned against a live key, circle co-present) where Compose is a CANVAS (commit-first). The gap: `renderChordChips()` plays the tap and DISCARDS it, so an ordered by-ear chord sequence - real creative output - is lost and re-entered by hand. Proposal, ranked: (1) **tap-trail capture** - remember the last N taps, offer "Keep these N -> Compose" via the existing seedKey bridge, trail clears on key change/close; (2) **name the pattern** - match the trail against songwriting-coach's proven families via `Circle.romanFor` and say "that is the Axis loop" + offer the canonical completion (teaches while he plays); (3) next-chord emphasis on the strip, **emphasis ONLY, never reordering** (the strip's calm comes from the 7 chips never moving - ux-coach recognition-over-recall); (4) audition-vs-commit mode in Compose = operator vision call, not assumed. Recommend building 1+2 as one feature. Full analysis: [design-audition-first-composing-20260903.md](design-audition-first-composing-20260903.md)

**RESEARCHED 2026-09-02, verdict: archive.org is NOT the answer (operator todo: "find royalty free backing tracks on archive.org to replace current set")**. Findings: (1) no archive.org item found carrying BOTH a confirmed license AND a stated key/bpm - the app's HUD treats key+mode as load-bearing, so an untagged track means ear-tagging every one (same curation burden as today, worse discovery); (2) licensing is murky - the Archive disclaims verifying uploader rights, so a user re-upload is not a license grant; (3) ARCHITECTURE: the Studio is built on `t.yt` + an `<iframe>` embed, so ANY direct-audio source needs a new track type (`t.audioUrl`) + a parallel `<audio>` player path - a real feature, not a URL swap, and exactly what **S-LOCAL-JAM** (operator-records-his-own-loops) already scopes. Streaming mechanics UNVERIFIED (archive.org egress blocked in-container - `<audio>` hotlinking likely fine since CORS only gates Web Audio, but untested). Recommendation: don't build against archive.org; S-LOCAL-JAM is the path with no open legal questions. Cheapest next step if pursuing anyway: operator opens 3-5 candidate identifiers in a browser and checks for a real CC/PD badge + audible key

**Friction (surface-side, operator-flagged 2026-07-11): the Claude Android app DROPPED a typed operator message** - his preferences burst ("using metaphors in lyrics... compounded from previous sessions") never arrived and had to be re-sent via screenshot. Cost: one operator round-trip at ~1AM. Not fixable app-side from here; mitigation encoded: treat screenshots-of-typed-text as first-class burst input (already practiced), and the queues.json interview surface remains the durable channel for anything long.

**Friction (agent-side, self-caught 2026-09-25): a commit ran after a RED suite** because the run and the commit were joined with `;` instead of gated on the exit code, and a PR comment cited a commit SHA before it existed (corrected in place). Both rules already exist (evidence-integrity `unpiped-exit-code`, `no-unseen-artifact`); the miss was not applying them. Mitigation practiced for the rest of the arc: `if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then git commit ...; fi`, and SHAs pasted only from `git log` output.

**Friction: prescribed testing steps were not intuitive or possible.** The agent's "build C, Bb, F" test steps failed the operator: (a) Bb is non-diatonic to C so it's not offerable from the suggested/In-key palette (had to discover the All view + that Bb renders as A#), and (b) the agent had not traced the Skip path end-to-end, so the test could not have passed anyway (seq was dropped - see S-SOLO-SCALE-DEFAULT fix). Mobile-dev-coach lesson: never prescribe a manual test the agent has not traced as executable ON THE ACTUAL SURFACE and data-path. Encode: verify the code path carries the data before writing the test steps; write steps in the app's own vocabulary (All view, A# not Bb).
